question: Can a fixed distributed plasticity profile preserve replay-sensitive parameter groups while leaving enough cross-layer flexibility to recover quantity learning?

shadow_audit.quantity_source: the frozen Q2.6 seed-5 operation-request training split
shadow_audit.replay_sources: the six frozen Q2.6 replay training splits in their original order
shadow_audit.state_invariant: all weights and both AdamW moment arrays must be byte-identical before and after the audit

fixed_profile.normalization: N_g and O_g are quantity and replay mean-squared gradient energies divided by their respective cross-group medians
fixed_profile.adaptation: computed once by the no-update audit and immutable for the complete pilot
fixed_profile.delta_policy: scale the complete proposed AdamW weight displacement, including weight decay, by p_g
fixed_profile.weighted_projection: d_projected = d_scaled - max(0, dot(r,d_scaled) / sum_g(p_g * dot(r_g,r_g))) * (p elementwise r)
fixed_profile.moment_policy: each profile starts with fresh AdamW moments; moments produced by an accepted trial are retained within that profile and never reused across profiles
fixed_profile.hash_policy: the canonical profile and every audit input are SHA-256 bound before any paid pilot approval

leakage_firewall.checkpoint_selection: updates 0, 100, and 200 only under the frozen quantity/replay criteria; no language metric may select a checkpoint

proposed_paid_pilot.language_gate_condition: only one prospectively selected quantity-and-replay-valid frozen candidate

stop_conditions: audit mutates any weight or optimizer byte
the weighted projection fails to remove positive first-order replay drift within numerical tolerance
any forbidden evaluation source is supplied
the fixed profile or its input hashes differ from the approved bindings
